About this Event

Goth Yoga in North Beach

Goth Yoga returns once again, on All Hallows Eve, to the Church of Mother Gong. Join us for an afternoon of stretching, breathing, and getting a little weird in North Beach.
This all-levels class is a chance to slow down, move around, and enjoy yoga with a slightly darker disposition. Beginners are very welcome—no special flexibility, experience, or goth credentials required.
Some mats and blocks will be available, but please bring your own if you have them.
If you wish to save on ticket fees, in-person cash and card payments are available.

Also check out other in San Francisco, Health & Wellness events in San Francisco, Workshops in San Francisco.
